mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (above 4.5%) compresses corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede corporate earnings declines and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.2pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST > 1600 and RSAFS > 360000.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-driven expansion regime (indicated by rising industrial production), manufacturing output growth supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances during periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP (above 11000 billion dollars) indicates a robust economic expansion, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 > 11000.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL increasing by more than 0.3 percentage points over three months) signals potential central bank tightening and real interest rate hikes, which typically lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases by >0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 135000 and UNRATE < 4.7.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market expansion (HOUST above 1650), residential construction activity supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1650.
